text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And so, Master Tactician.
Do you have any plans for Christmas?

One day, with Christmas just around the corner,
No Reason suddenly asked me a question.
It's our holiday. Could there be somewhere she wants to go together—?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, is that so! I've got a banquet planned with
my friends! I'm so looking forward to it, I can
hardly wait!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Since I'm hosting, there's meals and gifts and what not?
Preparing it all is quite the chore—ah, busy, busy!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And so, what does one eat
at this Christmas banquet?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I know not of these Christmas banquets!
Yet Mirako tells me they are a veritable feast—
that extravagant meals and massive desserts are the tradition!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hence, I am thinking of catching sea bream and preparing a mountain of ohagi.
What say you? Is it Christmas yet?

It's not bad as a meal,
but whether it feels like Christmas is a bit questionable.
"She seems to be aiming for a Christmas-like event, but... will she be able to prepare everything properly?"
choice_data_list: Would you like some help with the preparations?

text_block_list.text: And so—
The day before the "Christmas Banquet."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Time to go shopping!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
No, I truly appreciate your aid!
With thee by my side, I feel a hundred times stronger!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: And so, food first, is it—let's see?
choice_data_list: Generally speaking, Western food is more common, I guess.

text_block_list.text:
For instance, roast beef or roast chicken.
Beef stew, pizza, potato salad... are probably common staples prepared in Japan.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho, I see, I see.
However, there are so many options...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"So, go on, do you have any recommendations?
Your personal picks!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
And cake is the standard dessert, apparently!
Let's see here~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Whipped cream, chocolate, tarts,
some with strawberries on top, others with them inside—
Is that one... shaped like a tree?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: ...The grape one, the melon one, chestnut—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nwaaaah! There are so many of them!
What is with this Christmas thing?!

...Suddenly, a certain cake catches my eye.
It's one I've had before, and it was delicious.
choice_data_list: Shall I show you my recommendations?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Oho, why didst thou not say so sooner~! Let us go with that! Lead the way, lead the way!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Alright, lastly, a present—a gift!
I've already got an idea in mind. Heheh!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Thou mayest wander about at leisure while thou waitest.

"Watching her head straight toward the back,
I picked up a book that caught my eye to kill some time and flipped through its pages."
choice_data_list: (One way or another, all the preparations are done!)

text_block_list.text:
I hope it turns out to be
a delightful Christmas party, but—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "Tastes so baaaaad!!"

The day of the Christmas party.
As I was finishing up work as usual—
I suddenly got a call from No Reason.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "I FORGOT THE CAKE!!!!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: "I completely forgot that I'd left it chilling in the trainer's room fridge! And then—"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"D-Don't cry, Mirako~!
Please, Trainer, bring it over~!"

Looking inside the trainer's office fridge,
the cake I bought yesterday was indeed in there.

I don't know how it got in here, but
for now, I hold the box tight and rush to the venue—!
And so.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Merry Christmas, I say~!
No Reason was the only one there.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyah-ha-ha-ha!
A smash-ing success~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
All lies!
A feast with friends was never on the table to begin with!

"Then what was that grocery shopping trip for?!"
Just as I was about to say that—

Suddenly,
a delicious aroma wafted past my nose.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
...Kakaka, come, have a seat.
Everything is fully prepared for our feast!

Forced into a flashy hat, seated at a decorated table, looking at the food.
...Every single dish is one of my favorites.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Naturally, since thou didst tell me thine own favorite food thyself.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Look, look, have some cake, it's your favorite, right?
There are presents too, open them, open them!

After thanking them and opening the present, inside was...
the very book I had picked up and taken interest in at the bookstore that day.

I see... That day, No Reason pretended
to have me help with preparations just to scout out
what I liked and wanted.

Once I figured out one piece, everything else fell right into place.
Asking about my Christmas plans, having cake in the Trainer's room... it all—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nya-ha-ha! I made 'em eat their words!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Merely inviting you to a banquet lacks flair.
And so, I prepared a little spectacle, you see~

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well now, were you surprised~?
Was it fun~?
Of course I was surprised... Originally, it was supposed to be a day with nothing planned at all.

"For her to brighten up such a day this much,
how could I not be happy?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: You've taken good care of me, after all. Consider this a reward from me!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Today, let us feast to our hearts' content!
Drink, make merry, sing, and dance!
With that said—onward!

—And No Reason vigorously
popped open the bottled cola—!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Ah, wha-wha-whaaaat!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Y-You spilled it all over the place~!?
A rag! Someone get a rag~!

Though cleaning took so long that eating was put on hold for a while...
I was able to spend a heartwarming day together with her.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well, well?! Were you surprised?!
Was it fun?!
Of course I was surprised... Originally, it was supposed to be a day with nothing planned at all.

"For her to brighten up such a day this much,
how could I not be happy?"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: You've taken good care of me, after all. Consider this my reward to you as well!

"Because you take good care of me"—
Hearing that... it suddenly hits me.
I didn't prepare any present at all.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hm? Well, of course. You were lured here under false pretenses, after all.

Even if she says that, she's still my trainee Umamusume.
I should have at least prepared something...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
............
Did I not tell you it was also meant as a reward?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Why do you think I went out of my way to make it so elaborate?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Fool! It's because *I* wanted to see it!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Thou didst labor on my behalf, didst come in haste, and thus—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: The way you look so completely dumbfounded is priceless~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nyahahaha!
Yes, yes, exactly that! That's the way~!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
There is no better gift than this!
You are at your best when you are being a fool.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Be foolishly amazed and laugh like fools!
At least for today! Nyahahaha!
And so, our banquet for just the two of us began. The room she had prepared was bright, lively, and warm.
